notes.title: Project Fireball 1.0 has launched
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks to all of you who have played Project Fireball so far. We are extremely happy to announce that the game is now available in 1.0

It is free and it is only on Steam so wait no more and jump in the arena !!

Among the really cool updates since the Open Alpha early October, we are happy to mention :

- 👯 [b]6 new characters are entering the Arena[/b]
Matadora, GravitySlam, The Mountain, Midas, Cleocos and Boombeast are available in (and only in) our "Ultimate roster pack" DLC available for purchase in Steam. Besides their incredible and unique flow, each of them also has a unique "passive ability" and a special twist to the "ultimate" shot, bringing in more depth of gameplay.
The DLC is available here 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299530/Project_Fireball__Ultimate_roster_pack

- 🔒 [b]The "Private match" feature [/b]
We are happy to let you know that the "private match" mode will be available. This means you will be able to create your own game and invite your friends to play. So what are you waiting for ? Invite them to wishlist the game and join the Discord already!

- 🤖 [b]The Bots[/b]
The bots are now available. The neverending waiting time when you try to play at 4am is now over ! Matches will be filled in by our AI in case the matchmaking is not totally filled in.

- 🎶 [b]The Music[/b]
Project Fireball in its 1.0 version already boasts original scores that were made specifically for the game vibe by our artists.


Also, don't forget to join our Discord to keep the conversation going !
https://gmlft.co/discord-fireball  

Thanks for all your support so far — enjoy the game !!

The Project Fireball team !

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Gameloft
